blocks.text: New York, United States—Weather conditions are a “major” focus of an investigation into a weekend private plane crash that killed nine people, US transportation investigators said Monday. At a briefing, Tom Chapman of the National Transportation Safety Board, retraced the ill-fated journey of the Learjet 60, which departed Austin, Texas at 1537 GMT Sunday on a trip to North Eleuthera in the Bahamas. The plane plummeted into a neighborhood in Palm Beach County in southern Florida, killing everyone on board.
